items.source: This annotation is targeted at Repository interfaces, indicating that the framework should ensure a N1QL Primary Index is present on the repository's associated bucket when the repository is created.
items.translation: 此注解针对 Repository 接口，指示框架在创建仓库时，应确保其关联的 bucket 上存在 N1QL 主索引。
